reason: The Specified by recipient button is announced as a plain button with no states, although it is the selected payment method and only a CSS class shows that. Neither button exposes a pressed, checked or selected state, and the Payment method legend sits in a plain div, not a fieldset, so the group has no name either. Tab from Email skips the selected button (tabindex -1) and lands on the other one. Space switches the choice, but the new selection is again shown only by a CSS class.

The Specified by me button is announced as a plain button with no states, so a screen-reader user cannot tell which of the two payment methods is chosen. Neither button exposes a pressed, checked or selected state, and the Payment method legend sits in a plain div, not a fieldset, so the group has no name either. Tab from Email skips the selected button (tabindex -1) and lands on the other one. Space switches the choice, but the new selection is again shown only by a CSS class.
